mapper.select: select mn.*, ci.Ci_Name as ciName, ci.Ci_Code as ciCode, ci.Ci_Type as ciType, ci.Ci_Expection as ciExpection, ci.Ci_describe as ciDescribe, ci.ci_Indicator as ciIndicator, ci.ci_Method_Data as ciMethodData, ci.Ci_Compute_Expection as ciComputeExpection, CI2.ci_Name as ciParentName, su.U_Name as checkPersonUname from task_distribution_check mn left join check_item ci on ci.Ci_Id = mn.Ci_Id left join Check_Item CI2 on CI2.ci_Id = ci.Ci_Parent left join sys_user su on su.U_id = mn.Check_Person_Uid where mn.td_Id = #{tdId} order by mn.order_No

select mn.*, mn.Dm_Drawing as diDrawing, td.task_Name as taskName, td.task_Code as taskCode, mn.dm_Region_Name as diRegionName, mn.dm_Code as diRegionCode, pro.p_Id as pId, td.td_Id as tdId, td.task_user_ids as taskUserIds, td.task_user_names as taskUserNames, pro.p_Name as pName from Drawing_Management_Catalogue mn
left join task_Distribution td on td.dm_Id = mn.dm_Id left join pre_project pro on pro.P_id = mn.p_id where mn.dm_Id = #{dmId} and td.state = 7
